newsitem.title: USA: Boise Cascade Office, Versand in marketing pact.
newsitem.headline: Boise Cascade Office, Versand in marketing pact.

text.p: Boise Cascade Office Products Corp, said Monday it has formed a joint venture with Otto Versand to offer direct marketing of office products in Europe.

The first marketing project will be in Germany where Otto has a $30 million office products catalog operation that will become part of the joint venture. Completion of the joint venture is subject to German Cartel Office approval.
Boise Cascade Office and Otto will each have a 50 percent equity interest in the venture. Otto is the world's largest direct marketer of consumer goods with annual revenues exceeding $15 billion.
